author: Cameron Macedonio
title: Man shot by HPD officer charged with two crimes - NewsBreak
text:
By Cameron Macedonio ,
5 hours ago
HONOLULU (KHON2) — The suspect who was shot by a Honolulu Police Department officer on Feb. 15 near Hālawa Housing was charged with two counts of Terroristic Threatening in the First Degree.
Kay-Pee K. Palik Jr., 22, was charged with the crimes following a domestic dispute where he allegedly punched his 16-year-old brother and 18-year-old sister, according to Interim Chief Rade Vanic.
The incident took place at approximately 10:22 p.m., with Pali arming himself with a “sizable” knife and advancing toward officers.
Domestic dispute in Hālawa ends in officer-involved shooting According to Vanic, responding officers had used a stun gun on Palik, to no avail. When he continued to not cooperate, a veteran officer shot one round at his thigh, Vanic said.
Palik received immediate first aid and was later hospitalized in serious condition. Upon his release from the hospital, he was taken into custody.
His charges came on Feb. 18.
The officer who shot Palik was placed on administrative leave as HPD investigates, per department policy.
